cards.front: Recall a key point about Command Words & Question Types
cards.back: OCR J198 uses specific command words that determine the depth and type of response required

cards.front: Recall a key point about Command Words & Question Types
cards.back: 'Describe' means give an account of what happened — focus on factual detail and chronological order

cards.front: Recall a key point about Command Words & Question Types
cards.back: 'Explain' requires giving reasons or causes — show how and why something happened

cards.front: Recall a key point about Command Words & Question Types
cards.back: 'Explain the significance/importance' demands you show both what happened and why it mattered

cards.front: Recall a key point about Command Words & Question Types
cards.back: 'How far' or 'To what extent' questions require a balanced argument with a judgement

cards.front: Recall a key point about Command Words & Question Types
cards.back: 'Assess the validity' of a statement means evaluate how true it is using evidence

cards.front: Recall a key point about Command Words & Question Types
cards.back: 'Compare' requires identifying similarities AND differences between two things

cards.front: Recall a key point about Command Words & Question Types
cards.back: Short-answer questions (2-4 marks) need concise, focused responses

cards.front: Recall a key point about Command Words & Question Types
cards.back: Medium-mark questions (6-8 marks) need developed explanations with specific evidence

cards.front: Recall a key point about Command Words & Question Types
cards.back: Extended questions (12-15 marks) require sustained argument, analysis and judgement

cards.front: Recall a key point about Command Words & Question Types
cards.back: The Period Study paper focuses on narrative and causation; the Depth Study focuses on analysis of sources and interpretations

cards.front: Recall a key point about Command Words & Question Types
cards.back: Always identify the command word before planning your answer

cards.front: What should you know about gcse ancient history exam tips — command words & question types?
cards.back: 1. For Command Words & Question Types, include specific factual detail: dates, names, events and statistics where relevant 2. For source questions, analyse provenance (who, when, why, audience) before using the content 3. In evaluation questions, discuss multiple factors and weigh their relative significance 4. Always link back to the question focus — don't just narrate what happened with Command Words & Question Types 5. Use phrases like 'the most significant factor was... because...' to show analytical judgement
